title: Gantt view fails on every hosted tenant: it asks for 10001 rows in one query and the hosted 5000-row page cap refuses it ("Query parameter 'top' asks for 10001 rows")
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Source: a live hosted customer, reported by the maintainer with a screenshot and relayed by a card thread of this project. Filed by the seat for that thread, which is building the fix.

Suggested-type: Bug
Suggested-grade: p1 (live customer; the view is fully unusable on every hosted tenant)
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`
Suggested-area: `area:ux`

## Symptom

On a hosted tenant (HotCRM PSA app, object `crm_project_task`, gantt view `project_plan`), the view shows only:

> Error: Query parameter 'top' asks for 10001 rows; this deployment's maximum page size is 5000. The query was not run.

## Cause (read on main `9348f02b`)

- `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` sends a single find with `nonGridRowCeilingQuery(GANTT_ROW_CEILING)`, which is `$top` 10001 (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/non-grid-row-ceiling.ts`).
- Hosted sets `OS_DATA_MAX_PAGE_SIZE=5000`, which refuses any `$top` above 5000 (`packages/types/src/query-read-limits.ts`).
- Calendar, map and tree send `$top` 2001 the same way. That is under the hosted cap, but any deployment with a cap below 2001 refuses it too.

## Fix direction (no server or spec change; ceilings unchanged)

Add one shared walk in `@object-ui/core` that fetches the non-grid ceiling plus the probe row in fixed steps:
- each step is `$top` = step, with `$skip` advancing;
- it stops at a short page or at ceiling + 1;
- the step stays at or under the deployment's page cap;
- the sort gets a unique tiebreak, so offset windows neither duplicate nor skip rows.

The gantt and the other single-shot `nonGridRowCeilingQuery` callers use it. The precedent is `plugin-list` `calendarWindow.ts` `fetchCalendarWindow`.

## Done when

- The gantt view on a deployment with `OS_DATA_MAX_PAGE_SIZE=5000` draws its rows, and the over-ceiling notice still appears past 10000.
- Calendar, map and tree work under a page cap below 2001.
- Tests pin both.
